correctness.rationale: The first two iterates give the exact solution polynomial α[(2+β)I-αA]. For a Stieltjes matrix only its diagonal can obstruct entrywise nonnegativity, yielding an if-and-only-if fixed-matrix criterion and a sharp spectral-class criterion. Substitution of the published optimal quadratic parameters reduces the condition to κ≤9. For diagonal systems the scalar error is exactly q^k[U_k(c)-qU_{k-1}(c)]; the standard Chebyshev bound proves nonnegativity at every iteration for q≤1/2, and the L-mode gives a second-iterate failure for q>1/2. Exact replay returns VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: Heavy-ball momentum is a canonical acceleration method, while Stieltjes and diagonal positive systems arise when coordinates represent populations, probabilities, concentrations, or positive discretized fields. The result gives an exact parameter-level safety criterion and shows that the classical optimal acceleration loses that safety precisely beyond condition number nine. The all-iterate diagonal theorem demonstrates that the threshold is not merely a one-step artifact, while the two-dimensional strict witness makes the failure directly reproducible.
